searchText: Definetly, I got really sick over the weekend and so lagging on this. I'm going to merge https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/3203 manually, but would love it if someone can help me understand why the bot seems to be blind to it. First step. Posted the Draft of the Spec in Eth-1.0 specs https://github.com/ethereum/eth1.0-specs/blob/master/network-upgrades/berlin.md Would be nice if the EIP title was included next to each EIP. Also, why does 2315 have a commit hash linked to it? I can add them. Also, we should put pressure on authors of all of those EIPs to get them moved into review. First one I clicked on has a number of editorial issues that need to be addressed which would be caught by an editor reviewing it (which will happen when a PR is created to move it to review status). It also may be valuable to have a table of EIPs (rows) by clients (columns) that has a green check or red x in each field based on which EIPs the clients have implemented and merged. Just having Geth be "not code merged" doesn't fully capture the situation. Updated the titles Changed it to a chart also removed the commit hash. holdover from yolov3 I don't think needs to be repeated here. This is a good idea. https://github.com/ethereum/eth1.0-specs/pull/13/files merged 👏 Checks look a lot better thanks! I feel like we should update these to point towards the specs repo so people who go to the eips website know it has changed: * https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-2070 * https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-2378 My weak preference would be to just remove them. The EFI one may not have all of its information available elsewhere at the moment (not sure). I'm a bit concerned that anyone who hasn't followed the process would not know where to find these things. Afri asking on twitter is a good example imo. But not a super strong opinion 👍 I feel like there are few enough people following the process that don't follow ACD calls that we can just redirect them when they ask. That is, I don't think we need a formal process for redirecting users because it is a relatively small problem that we can deal with on an ad-hoc basis. I'm for removing the content Might be nice to keep the links And include (this EIP has been deprecated in favor of ____ which is found ____)
